## INCIDENT REPORT: MTA-2026-02-28 Network Forensic Analysis

### Victim Host
- **IPv4 Address:** 10.2.28.88
- **MAC Address:** 00:19:d1:b2:4d:ad
- **Windows Hostname:** DESKTOP-TEYQ2NR
- **Logged-In User:** brolf

### Malware Family
**Emotet (Win32/Heodo)**
- **Attribution Type:** Behavioral (signature-unconfirmed)
- **Confidence:** High

#### Attribution Basis
The malware exhibits the distinctive C2 communication pattern and behavioral signatures of Emotet:
- Bare-IP HTTP POST beaconing to a single external IP
- Unencrypted HTTP requests to /fakeurl.htm (URI consistent with Emotet variants)
- Regular 60-second heartbeat interval with structured POST requests
- C2 responses with CMD=POLL (keep-alive) and CMD=ENCD (encoded commands) format
- Initial beacons larger (~220-490 bytes) with system reconnaissance data; subsequent beacons standardized (~286 bytes)
- C2 commands encoded with ES=1 (encrypted/secured flag) containing binary payload data

### Indicators of Compromise

#### Command-and-Control Endpoints
| Type | Value | Port | Protocol |
|---|---|---|---|
| IP Address | 45.131.214.85 | 80 | HTTP |
| URL | http://45.131.214.85/fakeurl.htm | 80 | HTTP |

#### Beaconing Behavior
- **Pattern:** POST request every 60 seconds
- **Request Type:** HTTP POST with application/x-www-form-urlencoded content
- **Duration:** Continuous from 2026-02-28 23:55:51 UTC through 2026-03-01 04:16 UTC (observed capture window)
- **Total Beacons Observed:** 273+ confirmed C2 checkins

#### C2 Protocol Indicators
- **Heartbeat Response:** `CMD=POLL\nINFO=1\nACK=1\n`
- **Command Response Format:** `CMD=ENCD\nES=1\nDATA=<binary>`
- **Response Characteristics:** Variable-length encoded/encrypted command payloads (36-244 bytes observed)

#### Extracted C2 Response Samples
| Filename | Size | SHA256 |
|---|---|---|
| fakeurl.htm (keep-alive) | 36 B | 2b69346572041eefe558a82b58d654237e087ce9ab4e0876254a40a8954279a9 |
| fakeurl(1).htm (encoded cmd) | 69 B | 2357d0f3455f3503085c4af2543eec16315223eefeebb3f611f0933d229ae6e7 |
| fakeurl(2).htm (encoded cmd) | 244 B | 98cf8b62e22638ceeea90caaa3083f9dfc698a5e8277b372e28d55acdf457a12 |

### Traffic Context (Benign)
The following traffic observed in the capture is benign and not indicative of malicious activity:
- Windows domain traffic (LDAP, SMB2, Kerberos) to 10.2.28.2 (EASYAS123-DC.easyas123.tech)
- Microsoft Edge/Windows Update delivery to CDN endpoints (23.218.232.148 serving msedge.b.tlu.dl.delivery.mp.microsoft.com)
- Adobe product updates (acroipm2.adobe.com, armmf.adobe.com, assets.adobedtm.com)
- Windows connectivity checks (msftconnecttest.com)

### Summary
Host 10.2.28.88 (DESKTOP-TEYQ2NR, user brolf) is infected with Emotet malware and actively beaconing to C2 infrastructure at 45.131.214.85:80. The malware maintains persistent command-and-control communication via HTTP POST to /fakeurl.htm with a 60-second heartbeat interval. Immediate isolation and forensic collection recommended.
